records.name: Government Aviation Training Institute
records.statutory_basis: state aviation training institute; DGCA-approved flying training organisation
records.evidence: The official GATI site describes a Government of Odisha aviation training institute and publishes admissions/training for commercial pilot licensing under DGCA rules. It is a regulated vocational training institute rather than a university.
notes: Classified in G9 (open, distance, skill and diploma institutions).

records.name: Deccan College Pune
records.statutory_basis: deemed-to-be university under UGC Act Section 3
records.evidence: The official Deccan College site identifies the Post-Graduate and Research Institute as a deemed university and publishes postgraduate and doctoral academic programmes in archaeology, linguistics and related fields.

records.name: National Museum Institute
records.statutory_basis: deemed-to-be university under UGC Act Section 3; Ministry of Culture institute
records.evidence: The official NMI site identifies the institute as a deemed university under the Ministry of Culture and publishes postgraduate programmes and admissions in art history, conservation and museology.

records.name: Archaeological Survey of India Training Institute
records.statutory_basis: Archaeological Survey of India departmental training institute
records.evidence: The official ASI site identifies this as departmental training for ASI officers and heritage professionals, including excavation and conservation training, rather than an open-admission degree institution.
notes: Keep in X because the route is departmental/professional training, not general college admission.

records.name: Jadavpur University
records.evidence: The official university site identifies Jadavpur University as a public university established under the Jadavpur University Act and publishes undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral admissions.

records.name: Kendriya Hindi Sansthan
records.statutory_basis: autonomous institute under the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
records.evidence: The official institute site identifies Kendriya Hindi Sansthan as an autonomous educational institute governed by Kendriya Hindi Shikshan Mandal under the Ministry of Education and lists its academic programmes and regional centres.

records.name: Sangeet Natak Akademi
records.statutory_basis: national academy established by the Government of India for music, dance and drama
records.evidence: The official Akademi site describes the national apex body for performing arts, awards, grants and archives; it is not an open-admission degree college.
notes: Keep in X as a national cultural academy rather than presenting it as a college.

records.name: Bhatkhande Music Institute
records.statutory_basis: deemed-to-be university under UGC Act Section 3
records.evidence: The official institute site identifies Bhatkhande Music Institute as a deemed university and publishes certificate, diploma, undergraduate and postgraduate music programmes.

records.name: ITC Sangeet Research Academy
records.statutory_basis: company-funded residential guru-shishya music training academy
records.evidence: The official SRA site describes a privately funded residential academy that selects scholars through audition and provides advanced Hindustani classical music training; it is not a UGC university or degree college.
notes: Classified as a private training provider (G10b), not a university.

records.name: KM Music Conservatory
records.statutory_basis: private music conservatory offering diploma and degree-linked music education
records.evidence: The official conservatory site publishes admissions for music performance, composition, production and sound-design programmes. It is a private specialist conservatory rather than a UGC university, so it belongs in G10b.
notes: Do not treat the Berklee collaboration as independent UGC university status.
